title: Grouping widgets in a Panel
body: I would like to group different ToggleRefinement Widgets in 1 panel, so they have 1 header and the header isn't shown when all the toffleRefinement counts are 0.

comments.body: At the moment we don't have this feature as part of the panel widget unfortunately, and panel is a quite complex widget, so I'm not sure what way it could wrap multiple widgets. The DOM wouldn't be exactly what you want, but could you have a header only for the first widget, but use the same condition to hide the widgets?

I don't think that would work.
In my DOM I have a header and a container. Together it forms an accordion. So clicking on the header would open or close the accordeon.

In my JS, I have a loop that creates toggleRefinment Widgets and adds it to the container only when the count is > 0.
But in order not to show an empty accordion I would have to check if all toggleRefinment Widgets have a count that equals 0.
But I don't know how I can do this.

Thanks for the quick response.
I'll try it out and let you know how I go ;-)

Worked like a charm.
Thank you very much, you are a life saver :smile:
